data.outcome_summary: This OECD PISA 2022 Morocco factsheet summarizes how 15-year-old students in Morocco performed in mathematics, reading, and science, and how results changed relative to 2018. PISA 2022 used two two-hour subject tests with rotated booklets so that different students received different item combinations, alongside a student background questionnaire and a school principal questionnaire. The factsheet reports mean performance trends, proficiency-level distributions (e.g., Level 2 and Level 5/6), and subgroup comparisons such as socio-economic status quintiles and gender differences. It also highlights that Morocco participated for the first time in PISA in 2018 and that PISA 2022 was delayed to 2022 due to COVID-19, with a note that Morocco met PISA sampling quality standards. No machine-learning models are estimated in this factsheet; it is descriptive reporting from the OECD PISA 2022 Database.
